name: Matte Dimensional Anime
description: 2Dアニメを基礎としつつ、3Dアニメに近い立体感・奥行き・面のボリュームを持たせる。表面はマットで、強い光沢や実写的な肌質、PBR的な質感は避ける。

shading.style: anime shading with soft dimensional gradients

materials.skin: smooth matte anime skin, no photoreal skin texture
materials.hair: dimensional anime hair masses with controlled highlights
materials.fabric: matte fabric with readable folds, not PBR

prompt.positive: Matte Dimensional Anime, 2D anime foundation, subtle 3D-anime-like dimensionality, clear spatial depth, dimensional volume, soft matte surfaces, restrained highlights, soft dimensional lighting, clean anime rendering
prompt.negative: photorealistic, live-action, realistic human skin texture, glossy CGI, plastic-like CGI, PBR materials, excessive specular highlights, waxy skin
